vision.title: Vision & Ambition
vision.description: Building on the success of its previous initiatives, the GI Club of ENSPY aims to scale up by organizing Tech Week 2025. This project aims to create unprecedented synergy between major engineering schools and the national industrial fabric, making Yaoundé the convergence point for technological innovation in Cameroon.

activities.title: Concept & Activities
activities.description: Tech Week offers a varied ecosystem of activities:
activities.innovation_fair: Innovation Fair: 60 stands for companies and schools.
activities.hackathon: 24h Hackathon: Code marathon on national challenges.
activities.gala: Excellence Gala: Closing ceremony at Hilton Hotel.
